meaning: Obligation tracking, not a test result or release certificate. All full contracts remain unproven; foundation code/test references identify only narrower work.

foundations.limits: initial values for 755 forms; not full per-field conformance, runtime activation or accessibility certification
restricted source projection and existing literals; no include/scope completeness or preview isolation proof
single Lua root in GUI; no include graph, changed-revision merge, checkpoint journal or watched-path certification
version/descriptions fixtures; no actual host compositor certificate, other inspectors or event subscription

blueprint_sections.requirement: Concrete scalar codecs checked against source
Structured editors and their model contracts
Draft storage, publication and runtime apply
Engineering work orders and proof gates
What this blueprint does and does not establish

engineering_orders.requirement: Workspace/types plus request schema and error model
engineering_orders.acceptance: Strict decoding, role-bound operations, no direct UI mutation path
Every audited registry entry resolved; source/default/argument discrepancies explained

engineering_orders.requirement: Limited Lua/legacy parser and provenance graph
engineering_orders.acceptance: Inert import; lossless no-op; differential include/scope/variable fixtures

engineering_orders.requirement: Instance-safe read transport and model reducer

engineering_orders.acceptance: No live reload on SaveDraft; ownership/conflict/metadata tests
Fault injection and watcher-gate tests before any real monitor/input apply
Every descriptor/variant/API node covered; ordering/lifecycle tests
Actual private frame/input without host sockets, active limits and verified teardown
Fidelity/omission labels backed by results; no unsafe fallback
Complete classified source schema and independent activation/recovery suite
Full coverage report, reference benchmarks and all mandatory security gates

security_gates.acceptance: Lua writes file/spawns process/loads library at top level; no effect occurs
Malicious parser result requests arbitrary path/span/operation; parent rejects
Quotes, controls, Unicode, delimiter/brace/statement payloads remain literal data
Two sessions, socket replacement, PID reuse and restart invalidate pending mutation
Watch active config while saving draft; no reload or active-file changes
Queued events, wildcard dirs, symlink target, autoreload callback changes and reentrant reload
Kill agent before/after each sync/rename/journal event; consistent recovery classification
Another writer changes source/published bytes; conflict, not blind overwrite
GUI SIGKILL and helper failure during risky change; armed recovery or explicit unavailability
Original compositor exits/restarts; no dispatch to replacement
Attempt home/runtime/Wayland/bus/agent/network/input/DRM-card access; denied
Infinite Lua/large allocation/fork storm/excess frames; resource termination and cleanup
Invalid JSON/version/duplicate key/depth/size/FD count/replayed sequence
Bad strides, overflow, mutable/truncated/nonregular FDs, wrong seals/format
Import/build/preview does not execute host commands or load native host plugins
Ordinary preview receives no host surface/password; shortcut capture stops on blur
Disabled enforcement/restart pending/narrow broker exception reported accurately
Traversal, symlinks, decompression bombs, malformed images/fonts/ICC/shaders
Repeated reload/apply leaves intended owned timers/binds/subscriptions once
Exit/kill/suspend/plugin/opaque reload effects cannot be labeled fully reversible
Redaction fixtures for titles, paths, usernames, tokens, environment and commands
Nix/store/system/generated/symlink roots cannot be silently overwritten
Tampered pack/dependency/runtime profile cannot gain write capability
Parser/lab socket cannot invoke writer methods; nonce/digest/role failures rejected

implementation_stages.requirement: Exact baseline exporter, current/released diffs, scalar/structured/API inventories, capability matrix
implementation_stages.acceptance: No unexplained registration omissions; aliases/defaults/bounds accepted by parser

implementation_stages.requirement: Instance selection, saved/active comparison, Lua/conf source graph, ownership detection
implementation_stages.acceptance: No execution on import; round-trip/no-change files byte-identical; unknown behavior labeled

implementation_stages.requirement: Undo/profiles, source patches, conflict handling, journaled writes and recovery
implementation_stages.acceptance: Crash/race/disk-failure tests pass; targeted mutation cannot cross instances

implementation_stages.id: 4. Low-memory native shell and all scalar editors
implementation_stages.requirement: Search, provenance, typed controls, complete baseline key coverage
implementation_stages.acceptance: Every scalar has meaningful edit/reset/validate/save tests; measured performance budget
Every descriptor/effect/action variant covered; precedence and activation semantics tested

implementation_stages.requirement: Safe sample plus actual isolated compositor bridge and scenario suite
implementation_stages.acceptance: Host-isolation tests pass; unsupported backend fails closed; teardown/resource caps verified

implementation_stages.requirement: API nodes, event/timer workflows, selectors/expressions, custom layouts
implementation_stages.acceptance: All supported public API argument forms represented; lifecycle/reload idempotence tested

implementation_stages.requirement: Independently versioned Hypr tools, selected ricing apps, Nix ownership/export
implementation_stages.acceptance: Per-adapter source inventories and activation/preview/security checks complete

implementation_stages.id: 9. Release hardening and ongoing schema maintenance
implementation_stages.requirement: Packaging, accessibility, diagnostics, signed updates, compatibility matrix
implementation_stages.acceptance: Full coverage report plus security/performance/hardware results; no silent unsupported entries

model_invariants.requirement: Unset, false, zero, empty and unknown remain distinct.
Finite floating-point values only; no NaN/infinity crossing serialization.
Source observations and active values are not automatically copied into the draft.
A declared literal is a syntactic saved declaration; opaque earlier code can invalidate certainty about its effective result.
Schema revision, document generation and session generation accompany every asynchronous request/result.
Older results are discarded, never rebound to a new session or modified draft.
A feature outside the selected pack's version membership is never serialized for live use.
UI descriptions, paths and IPC values are escaped display data.
Runtime handles are re-resolved immediately before an action; disappearing targets produce a typed error.
Opaque or unresolved fields cannot pass a “fully validated” gate by default.

source.name: config.props_refreshed
source.parameters: bool: `true` if the [prop refresh](../lua-utilities/#prop-refresh) event is being executed as scheduled, `false` if executed prematurely with the Lua function

source.name: input.keyboard.key
source.parameters: integer: XKB keycode; integer: Unix timestamp that the event occurred; integer: released (0), pressed (1), or repeated (2)

source.name: screenshare.state
source.parameters: Bool: Active, Integer: Type, String: Name

source.name: window.minimize
source.parameters: Window; bool: `true` if requesting minimization, `false` for unminimization

source.name: cursor_zoom
source.additional arguments: zoom_level` for a zoom factor, `mode` of `"mult"` to use a multiplier or `"live"` to update continuously during the pinch

source.name: float
source.additional arguments: mode` can be `"float"` or `"tile"` to force a direction of floating

source.name: fullscreen
source.additional arguments: mode` can be `"maximize"` to do maximize instead of fullscreen

source.name: fullscreen_state({ window?, action?, internal, client, layout_aware? })
window.pseudo
source.params: Left empty/`"active"` for current, or `"window"` for a specific window

source.name: cyclenext
source.params: either `loop` (allow looping from the bottom of the pile back to master) or `noloop` (force stop at the bottom of the pile, like in DWM). `loop` is the default if left blank.

source.name: cycleprev
source.params: either `loop` (allow looping from master to the bottom of the pile) or `noloop` (force stop at master, like in DWM). `loop` is the default if left blank.

source.name: focusmaster
source.params: either `master` (focus stays on master), `auto` (default; focus first non-master window if already on master) or `previous` (remember current window when focusing master, if already on master, focus previous or fallback to `auto`).

source.name: mfact
source.params: the new split ratio, a relative float delta (e.g., `-0.2`, `+0.2`) or `exact` followed by a value between 0.0 and 1.0

source.name: orientationcycle
source.params: allowed values: `left`, `top`, `right`, `bottom`, or `center`. The values have to be separated by a space. If left empty, it will work like `orientationnext

source.name: swapnext
source.params: either `loop` (allow swapping the bottom of the pile and master) or `noloop` (do not allow it, like in DWM). `loop` is the default if left blank.

source.name: swapprev
source.params: either `loop` (allow swapping master and the bottom of the pile) or `noloop` (do not allow it, like in DWM). `loop` is the default if left blank.

source.name: swapwithmaster
source.params: either `master` (new focus is the new master window), `child` (new focus is the new child) or `auto` (which is the default, keeps the focus of the previously focused window). Adding `ignoremaster` will ignore this dispatcher if master is already focused.

source.name: inhibit_scroll
source.params: left empty for toggle, or `bool` for explicitly enabling/disabling

source.name: e
source.limits: Wraps around if range exceeds amount of worksapces in the direction

source.name: m
source.limits: Wraps around if range exceeds amount of worksapces in the direction

source.name: empty
source.limits: Wraps around if it lands past the last numerical workspace, 2147483647
